description: Sessions about a topic on one specific conference day (exact day filter + full-text topic match on title, linked topics/technologies and abstract). Use for any question combining a topic with a date.

configuration.query: FROM conference_sessions METADATA _score | WHERE day == ?day AND is_content == true AND (MATCH(title, ?topic) OR MATCH(entity_names, ?topic) OR MATCH(description, ?topic)) | SORT _score DESC | KEEP title, day, starts_at_local, room_name, track, format, topics | LIMIT ?limit
